_meta.brand: مركز العافية — Saudi Wellness & Fitness Center Demo

grounding.source: sector truth: Saudi fitness centers, sports nutrition retail, wellness services; Riyadh gym culture

_meta.keys_source: synthetic_fake_organ_v1 — sector-representative Saudi wellness & fitness offerings
_meta.hard_truth: This is a Saudi wellness center; NO exposed athletic bodies; scenes are PUBLIC gym floors, outdoor parks, nutrition counters — never locker rooms or private spaces; modest sportswear only (covered arms and legs for mixed-zone contexts).
_meta.signature_serving_system: Clean gym environment with branded equipment. Nutrition bar counter with protein shakers and branded cups. Outdoor class mats. Membership cards and digital app. All presented in a clean, aspirational but accessible Saudi wellness aesthetic.

اشتراك شهري.identity_dna: A monthly membership card — matte black PVC with a gold logo emboss and the member's name in Arabic calligraphy typeface — paired with the brand's mobile app on a smartphone screen. The card is the physical promise; the app is the daily companion: tracks workouts, nutrition, and recovery. Access to full-floor gym, group classes, and the nutrition bar.
components: branded mobile app (dark UI, clean metrics)
اشتراك شهري.signature: The matte black card — weighty, minimal, premium — and the app's clean dark dashboard showing streaks and progress rings
اشتراك شهري.texture: Matte PVC card, smooth and cool to touch; app UI is dark-mode clean with white metrics and a single green progress ring

جلسة تدريب شخصي.identity_dna: A one-on-one personal training session — a certified Saudi trainer with a clipboard (programme card) and the client training on the gym floor using real equipment (dumbbells, resistance bands, functional rack). The SESSION is the product: an assessed plan, live form coaching, and a follow-up note card. Documentation of progress is part of the service.
components: live form coaching on gym floor
session note card for client records
جلسة تدريب شخصي.signature: A programme card, a hand on equipment, and a trainer's nod — the one-to-one relationship is the product
جلسة تدريب شخصي.texture: Gym rubber floor under grip shoes; the programme card is cream cardstock; dumbbells are matte iron, cool and dense in hand

بروتين طبيعي (واي بروتين).identity_dna: A clean-label whey protein supplement in a rigid matte canister — white with Arabic + English bilingual labelling, the nutrition facts table prominently displayed in Arabic. Two flavours: vanilla tahini and plain (unflavoured). Scoop included. No artificial colours; transparent ingredients list. Photographed next to a branded shaker, full of a pale-gold smoothie.
components: vanilla tahini OR plain unflavoured variant
بروتين طبيعي (واي بروتين).signature: Clean matte white canister, Arabic-forward label, beside a branded shaker filled with a pale gold shake
بروتين طبيعي (واي بروتين).texture: Fine powder, smooth-dissolving; shake has a light creamy texture; canister is rigid matte plastic with a snap-lock lid

خطة غذائية مخصصة.identity_dna: A personalised meal plan — delivered as a printed A5 card booklet (7 days × 3 meals) and as a PDF via WhatsApp/app. The plan is written in Arabic, with dish names, macros per meal, and a grocery checklist. The visual is the printed booklet on a clean desk surface next to a measuring cup and a date. Saudi-adapted meals (machboos-protein version, lean harees, egg+date breakfast) feature alongside international options.
خطة غذائية مخصصة.signature: A clean A5 meal plan booklet in Arabic — your week, your macros, your food; not a generic template
خطة غذائية مخصصة.texture: Clean matte card-stock booklet; measuring cup beside it is transparent plastic; dates on the side are amber-brown and soft

جلسة تعافي رياضي.identity_dna: A 45-minute sports recovery session — offered as foam-rolling guidance, percussion massage gun application, and stretching protocol — conducted in the centre's recovery zone (a dedicated quiet area with dimmed light, rubber mat floor, and branded recovery tools). The session ends with electrolyte drink. No beds; the session is on a mat on the floor in the semi-private open recovery area.
جلسة تعافي رياضي.signature: A recovery mat, branded tools, and the specific moment of muscle releasing under a percussion gun — private but not alone
جلسة تعافي رياضي.texture: Firm rubber mat underfoot; foam roller is high-density EVA; percussion gun is matte black and vibrates with precision; electrolyte drink is citrus-clear

ملابس رياضية محتشمة (طاقم جاهز).identity_dna: A ready-to-train modest sportswear set — full-length compression tights and a loose long-sleeve performance top in the brand's signature colour (charcoal grey / deep teal). Moisture-wicking fabric; UV50 rated for outdoor use; concealed waistband. Modest coverage: no midriff, no short sleeves, no fitted body-mapping cuts that reveal form. Photographed folded on a shelf or flat-laid on a gym mat — no body modelling.
ملابس رياضية محتشمة (طاقم جاهز).signature: A folded set — charcoal grey tights and teal loose long-sleeve — on a gym shelf. Modest, technical, Saudi-ready.
ملابس رياضية محتشمة (طاقم جاهز).texture: Smooth technical fabric with slight compression grip; waistband is flat and seamless; fold is clean and architectural when stacked

اشتراك تطبيق التتبع.identity_dna: A digital subscription to the brand's fitness tracking app — available on iOS and Android. The app shows: daily step count, workout logs, nutrition tracker (with Saudi food database including Arabic meals), sleep score, and a weekly progress ring. The UI is dark-mode by default; the brand's green accent marks goal completion. Shared-screen screenshots used for content — never intimate scenes.
components: weekly progress ring and streak counter
اشتراك تطبيق التتبع.signature: A dark-mode phone screen showing a green progress ring at 80% — the single metric that drives daily behaviour
اشتراك تطبيق التتبع.texture: Glass phone screen reflecting studio light; app UI is dark-slate with a sharp green accent; finger-tap on the screen for interaction moments

حصة يوجا في الهواء الطلق.identity_dna: An outdoor yoga class — held in a park or the centre's external courtyard — using branded non-slip mats in a circle formation. The class is 50 minutes; flow is moderate pace with Arabic verbal instruction. Setting is public outdoor space; participants wear modest activewear; no form-fitting or midriff-baring. The mat is the hero prop: branded, rolled, placed on green grass or clean tile.
components: public park or centre courtyard setting
حصة يوجا في الهواء الطلق.signature: A rolled branded mat on green park grass in morning light — the only prop needed for an outdoor class that resets the week
حصة يوجا في الهواء الطلق.texture: Textured non-slip mat surface (slightly grippy under palm); grass is soft and damp in morning light; mat edges curl slightly when new
